Terms of use

The ground rules for playing together on Roam.

Using Roam

Roam is operated by [Legal operator name]. Keep your account secure and use Roam lawfully. Keep private invite codes and gift assignments within the intended group.

Playing with others

Treat other players with respect. Do not harass, impersonate, spam, or try to access someone else’s account or private game information.

Gift exchanges

Hosts and players arrange gifts themselves. Suggested budgets are guidance. Roam does not collect gift payments or arrange delivery.

Leaving Roam

You can leave groups or delete your account. Group owners may need to arrange a handover first.

Questions

Contact [Support email] for help or to report misuse.
